name: Runemaster Bursting Pulses: an Earth-engraved weapon shortens and strengthens Primordial Pulse (#1663)
contract: Bursting Pulses 300584 (Arcane tree talent, CharacterAdvancement 29222): 'Each weapon enchanted by Weapon
Engraving: Earth now reduces the cooldown of Primordial Pulse by $/1000;s1 sec and increases it's damage by
$s2%.' Its two effects are flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (-4000) and SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (+15) modifiers on family 38
mask2 0x2000000, which only Earth Engraving 'Passive2' 653221 carries. 653221 is the aura the engraving's equip
spell Earth Engraving 653219 brings; its effect 1 is a flat SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN and its effect 2 a percent
SPELLMOD_DAMAGE modifier, both 0 in Spell.dbc, on mask2 0x1: the Primordial Pulse ranks 300578 and 563203-563207
(CategoryRecoveryTime 20000) and its damage spell 520111. The native modifier chain applies the talent without
a script. Expected for one engraved weapon (653219 is a fixture aura; the format has no item-targeted cast):
without the talent 653221 changes nothing; with it 653221 reads -4000 and +15, Primordial Pulse's 20 sec
cooldown becomes 16 sec on a real cast and 520111 deals 15% more; removing the engraving removes both bonuses.
